name: Mayama Takahiro
source:
Star Sign: Capricorn
Job: Bartender
Hobby: Tennis, Cycling
Likes: Strawberries
Dislikes: Cats, Sweet and Sour Pork with Pineapple

Bartender at the bar "Casina". The bar is very important to him so he works hard every day.
A good young man who is always sincere.
